kjv: Verily it shall be well with thy remnant; verily I (Yahweh) will cause the enemy to entreat thee (Jeremiah) [well]
mine: Have I (Yahweh) not set you (Jeremiah) free for their good? Have I not pleaded for you before the enemy
note: The verse is obscure: ketiv sherotikha / qere sheritikha ("I have released you" or "your remnant"), and hipga'ti bekha ("I interceded with you" or "made the enemy entreat you"). Both renderings are attempts.
